items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I think he was Irene's favorite drummer. Was it Winton? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah, he was a gun nut.

ctx.x: I think he was Irene's favorite drummer. Was it Winton?
Bill Winston. He was Johnson's buddy. All them guys all carried those guns and pistols and rifles.
Oh, yeah, he was a gun nut.
